title: Agent One Finance
say: This is Agent One Finance: one governed platform where our accounting teams run reconciliations, reviews and commentary. The AI does the legwork. Our people make every decision.

title: The problem today
say: Today every break is investigated by hand: pull the data, find the cause, write it up, chase the sign-off. About twelve minutes a break, and every team builds its own tools.

title: Overview
caption: Everything waiting on you, across every capability
say: This is what Frank, a FOBO controller, sees when he logs in: hours saved, what is waiting for his review, what is overdue, and what has been escalated to a person.

title: Inbox
caption: Opened at 06:30 · most urgent first · money at stake
say: The work is done before he arrives. At six thirty, Agent One Finance opened yesterday's run for every Prime book, matched CATS to MOTIF and classified every break. The inbox puts the most urgent first, shows what is at stake, and filters to what needs his confirmation.

title: A case
caption: FOBO's own playbook decides · unconfirmed thresholds are flagged, not assumed
say: In a case, the card at the top says exactly what is needed: three groups to decide, one needs confirmation, one is a judgement call. This redemption break is back office, so FOBO's playbook says post. But the materiality threshold is not confirmed yet, so Agent One Finance asks for his confirmation instead of assuming. He can also see how this break was approved before.

title: Rule R2
caption: A front-office cause never posts: enforced in code
say: A front office cause never posts. That rule is enforced in code, whatever the table or the model says.

title: Escalated
caption: Can't prove it? A person decides, and sees why
say: When Agent One Finance cannot prove something, it escalates. This novel break has no proven side, so a person decides. The card says why in plain words, who owns it, and what the reviewer can do: approve with their own explanation, reject, or send it back to investigate again.

title: Ask about this case
caption: Plain-English questions · this case's data only · audited
say: Controllers can ask questions in plain English. Answers come only from this case's data, and every lookup is audited.

title: Sign-off
caption: One decision per pattern · tickets to owning teams · evidence ready
say: Breaks are grouped into patterns, so one decision covers many breaks. One click approves the routine groups; anything needing confirmation or judgement stays for one-by-one review. Once signed off, tickets go to the owning teams, and the evidence pack and Excel are ready for audit.

title: The controllers' skill
caption: MB Rec's breaks · the skill classifies · a controller approves before the model
say: Prime now starts from the breaks MB Rec already reconciled. The controllers' skill classifies each one, and the run stops at a tollgate: Frank checks it and adds what the desk said, before the model is asked anything.

title: The skill's answer and sign-off
caption: Answers in the skill's sections · its completion checklist before approval
say: Judgement breaks come back in the skill's own sections: root cause, tests not performed, verdict, remediation, end state. Before approving, Frank answers the skill's checklist, with what Agent One Finance already knows beside each question.

title: The next COB
caption: Every adjustment re-tested on the next COB · BO + adjustments = FO, or it stays open
say: On the next COB every adjustment is re-tested. The timing break cleared. The re-posted swap did not, so BO plus adjustments does not equal FO, and the investigation stays open for a person.

title: Rates team
caption: Same engine and playbook · its own books, thresholds and reviewers
say: The Rates team runs the same engine and the same playbook, with its own books, thresholds, schedule and reviewers. A new team is a configuration file, not a new project.

title: New use cases
caption: From a template or a requirement · checked · live on a second owner's approval
say: New work, such as accruals, substantiation or intercompany, starts from a template or a requirement, is checked by the platform, and goes live only when a second owner approves it.

title: Run the bank
caption: Entitlements on every call · masking · audit · cost caps · off switches
say: For technology, it is one platform to run. Every data access is checked against entitlements and audited. Sensitive data is masked before the model sees it. Costs are capped, and anything can be switched off in one click.

title: What it means
say: So analysts move from investigating to reviewing, one decision covers a whole pattern, and every team gets the same features and controls, as configuration rather than new builds.

title: Next steps
say: We propose a pilot on FOBO Prime and Rates, measuring hours saved against the twelve minute basis, then month-end accruals and substantiation. Thank you.
